list-page.tsx.title: List page
list-page.tsx.description: A user-management list with selection, search, filters, pagination, an Extensions Dialog creation form, an UploadFile import Dialog and SidePanel record details.
list-page.tsx.usage: Create user opens the copied Extensions Dialog with a validated FormField/Input/Dropdown form. With no onCreate callback, creation appends an in-memory user; onCreate(draft) delegates persistence and users refresh to the host. Import opens Dialog with Extensions UploadFile (.csv, up to 5 MB); onImport(file) submits to the host. Without onImport, confirmation only records the selected filename and does not parse/import CSV records. Both callbacks may return promises; failures remain in the dialog for retry. Connect onEdit, onExport, onBulkManagement and onRefresh to host workflows; unconnected host actions are disabled. Pass scenario from usePrototypeScenario() in Workspace; controls stay in the host toolbar. Details use the copied SidePanel. Keep table parents flush: no rounded card, outer border, shadow or horizontal insets. Pass batch guidance through messageComponent below the column header.
list-page.tsx.limits: No backend or durable storage is provided. Local creation resets on remount; CSV selection is not a completed server import. The host owns duplicate/persistence validation across sessions and refreshes supplied users after successful creation. BasicTable owns rendering and pagination; the page sorts and slices data. Selection persists across pages/filters. The 48px filter Toolbar reserves space, search moves below it on small viewports, and the wide table scrolls internally.

detail-page.tsx.title: Detail page
detail-page.tsx.description: Read-only user details with tabs, grouped fields and host-owned edit/delete/back actions.
detail-page.tsx.usage: Read the Props interface in the source; pass user, onBack, onEdit and onDelete from the host. Adapt record groups and tabs to the requested domain.
detail-page.tsx.limits: The sample is not a backend integration. Loading/error/permission states and routing need target-specific implementation; this recipe does not accept scenario.

form-page.tsx.title: Form page
form-page.tsx.description: Editable profile form with validation and save/cancel callbacks.
form-page.tsx.usage: Read the Props interface in the source; pass initial, onSave and onCancel. Connect submission and routing before delivery.
form-page.tsx.limits: No backend or persistent save is provided. Async submit/failure and permission states require target-specific implementation; this recipe does not accept scenario.

extensions/users-list.tsx.title: Users list with extensions
extensions/users-list.tsx.description: A compact extension-based list demonstrating local search, a create SidePanel and prototype scenario rendering.
extensions/users-list.tsx.usage: Mount the default UsersList export and pass scenario from usePrototypeScenario(). Replace sample records and connect persistence for a real application. Keep AppPageContent padding at zero around BasicTable; inset the search region independently.
extensions/users-list.tsx.limits: Creation is in-memory only; state is lost on remount. This compact recipe is not the full List page composition. Use ListPage for marketplace Toolbar, row selection and multi-page data.
